body: Founder asked to run GPT-2 (the existing gpt2-alpine-c fine-tune+inference pipeline already built for Emily Prime) over segments of the taxonomy data to identify/generate prompts for 'realities that don't yet exist as far as we are aware.' Grounded the connection in gpt2-alpine-c's real, already-built capabilities (prime_directive_dataset.py's corpus pattern, Colab fine-tune flow, serve.py inference API proxied through emily-agent) rather than inventing new infra. Distinguished this from section 2's pure observation-based discovery: this is extrapolation, training on the taxonomy-so-far to propose categories nobody has generated an example of yet -- a second-order use of the reverse-labeled dataset framing (labels generating more labels). Fits as a concrete NORN Proposer candidate for the discovery loop's existing Oracle/Gate. Disclosed honestly, not glossed: gpt2-alpine-c's Colab fine-tune pipeline exists in code but hasn't completed a first real run yet (S26-04, still open) -- this would be a new consumer of that pipeline, not something that resolves it. Also bumped the golden-docs-index token budget (2500->4500) to match the document's real size after several rounds of enrichment. Commits e937f19, 854d814, 082aab5, 3bfc8ee, 618f181.
title: Prompt-o-verse northstar: added GPT-2-assisted extrapolation for undiscovered categories
